text:
Alex M: Heads-up — we need a quick paid search sprint tomorrow AM to support the new webinar signup flow. Goal: keep CPC steady, avoid runaway spend. :eyes:
Priya S: Got it. Plan? do we swap creative or just scale existing winners?
Alex M: Swap creative for retarget pool B, small scale-up for top 3 keywords only. Pacing guard: daily cap + 20% burst window for first 2 hours, then throttle to baseline. :rocket:
Sam R: I can push the creative swap and update ad copy. Need exact creative IDs and tracking params.
Alex M: Creative IDs: C-9812, C-9813. New copy has the webinar CTA + urgency. UTM string below — please append to final URL:
```
?utm_source=paid_search&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_may&utm_content=creative_B
```
Jonas L: I'll set up a short dashboard view for first-hour pacing. Watch for CTR drop >20% and CPA spike. If CPA > 2x baseline we auto-fallback to prev creative. I'll post the link when ready.
Maya C: QA checklist — landing variant B needs the updated CTA and thank-you form mapped to /webinar-thanks-v2. I'll run a quick pass pre-launch.
Priya S: Also adding a 3hr rule: if spend hits 80% of hourly target before 45m, throttle keyword bids by -15%. Anyone object?
Sam R: fine by me. I'll schedule the swap at 09:00 PST, 60s precheck at 08:58. @deploy-bot can we add a reminder? :bell:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — will post in #marketing at 08:58 PST and ping @Priya S @Sam R @Alex M.
Alex M: Perfect. Jonas — can you make the dashboard alert push to our Ops channel if CPA spikes?
Jonas L: Yup — webhook -> #marketing-ops. I also hooked a lightweight anomaly detector: if CTR drops > 15% vs. baseline we mute the new creative and notify.
Maya C: QA done on staging. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/snap12345 (looks good).
Priya S: Uploading ads to the manager now. Tagging creatives and setting the pacing caps.
Sam R: Done — creative swap live in draft, will go live on schedule.
Alex M: Thanks team. Post-launch check in 09:15 for first 15-min readout. Keep messages here. :thumbsup:
